Small on purpose.

One counter, a short menu of things we believe in. Vienna Beef done right. Hand-built deli sandwiches. Jerk chicken from the islands. A bakery case anchored by the Chicago Lunchroom Butter Cookie.

Look for the No pork on my fork stamp on the all-beef line. That's a product promise, not a slogan.
